items.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq slumps 2.5%, S&P 1% as revived AI doubts ignite tech selloff
items.summary: US stocks fell sharply as renewed concerns over massive AI spending triggered a selloff in technology and semiconductor shares. The Nasdaq suffered its steepest one day decline since June, while the S&P 500 also dropped. Tesla and Meta fell, while oil prices climbed to a five-month high amid fresh Middle East tensions.

items.title: Treasuries see best day in over a year as AI selloff revives haven demand
items.summary: US Treasury bonds surged as a sharp selloff in AI-linked stocks revived demand for safe-haven assets. Treasury yields posted their biggest declines in more than a year, despite Brent crude rising above $112 a barrel. Investors also scaled back expectations for a December Fed rate hike amid growing concerns over AI spending and US growth.

items.title: Chana sowing holds key to pulses inflation
items.summary: Chana, India's most consumed pulse, which is central to making everything from salty snacks to nutritious meals, needs adequate soil moisture and cool weather for a good crop. Sowing has started in some regions, but the progress is slow. State advisories to conserve water and shift to less water-intensive crops have added to concerns over winter sowing.

items.title: Pershing's Ackman sees a $1 trillion Israeli company within a decade

He highlighted Israel’s technology ecosystem, AI potential and growing ambitions to build global companies, while saying the country’s small population could become an advantage.
